name: crosswordle
description: A crossword where every entry is solved as its own Wordle.

scripts.generate: tsx packages/generator/src/cli.ts generate --clues data/clues/quick.tsv --clues data/clues/edits.tsv --words data/wordlists --puzzles puzzles
scripts.generate:naughty: tsx packages/generator/src/cli.ts generate --clues data/clues-naughty/rude.tsv --words data/wordlists-naughty --puzzles puzzles-naughty --id-prefix naughty- --title-prefix "Naughty · " --min-entries 10 --max-entries 16 --max-size 11 --days 10
scripts.puzzles: tsx packages/generator/src/cli.ts publish --in puzzles --words data/wordlists --notice data/clues/NOTICE.md --out apps/web/public/puzzles --answers-out functions/_puzzles.json --clues2 data/clues/wordnet.tsv
scripts.puzzles:naughty: tsx packages/generator/src/cli.ts publish --in puzzles-naughty --words data/wordlists-naughty --notice data/clues-naughty/NOTICE.md --out apps/web/public/naughty --answers-out functions/_puzzles.naughty.json
scripts.words:naughty: tsx packages/generator/src/cli.ts words --words data/wordlists --words data/wordlists-naughty --out apps/web/public/words-naughty
scripts.dev: npm run puzzles && npm run puzzles:naughty && npm run words && npm run words:naughty && npm run dev -w @crosswordle/web
scripts.preview: npm run build && wrangler pages dev apps/web/dist
scripts.build: npm run puzzles && npm run puzzles:naughty && npm run words && npm run words:naughty && npm run build -w @crosswordle/web && node scripts/render-headers.mjs --format cloudflare --out apps/web/dist/_headers
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p functions/tsconfig.json && npm run check -w @crosswordle/web
